verdict.rationale: Bland is an API-driven voice platform, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question. However, the probe found no spec at any of the standard paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json all returned 404). The docs mention a Pathways API reference, and llms.txt is a documentation index rather than an API spec, so nothing in the pack shows a machine-readable spec. Confidence is medium because the probe covered only common paths.
